mapper.select: SELECT toString(ref_sample.stable_id) AS reference_sample_id, toString(ps.reference_sequencing_date) AS reference_sequencing_date, toString(portal_sample.stable_id) AS sample_id, part.part_key AS part_key, part.part_number AS part_number, part.part_designator AS part_designator, part.part_type AS part_type, part.part_description AS part_description, part.subspecialty AS subspecialty, part.path_dx_title AS path_dx_title, block.block_key AS block_key, block.block_number AS block_number, block.block_label AS block_label, slide.image_id AS image_id, slide.stain_name AS stain_name, slide.stain_group AS stain_group, slide.is_hne AS is_hne, slide.is_ihc AS is_ihc, slide.magnification AS magnification, slide.file_size_bytes AS file_size_bytes, slide.can_serve_tiles AS can_serve_tiles, slide.barcode AS barcode, slide.slide_type AS slide_type, placement.match_level AS match_level, placement.specimen_key AS specimen_key, placement.procedure_date_days AS procedure_date_days, placement.timepoint_source AS timepoint_source FROM cancer_study study INNER JOIN patient portal_patient ON portal_patient.cancer_study_id = study.cancer_study_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT cancer_study_id, argMax(active_version, (updated_at, publication_id)) AS active_version, argMax(publication_id, (updated_at, publication_id)) AS publication_id FROM wsi_publication_manifest GROUP BY cancer_study_id ) manifest ON manifest.cancer_study_id = study.cancer_study_id INNER JOIN wsi_patient_snapshot ps ON ps.cancer_study_id = manifest.cancer_study_id AND ps.snapshot_version = manifest.active_version AND ps.publication_id = manifest.publication_id AND ps.patient_id = portal_patient.internal_id LEFT JOIN sample ref_sample ON ref_sample.internal_id = ps.reference_sample_id LEFT JOIN wsi_part part ON part.cancer_study_id = ps.cancer_study_id AND part.patient_id = ps.patient_id AND part.snapshot_version = ps.snapshot_version AND part.publication_id = ps.publication_id LEFT JOIN wsi_block block ON block.cancer_study_id = part.cancer_study_id AND block.patient_id = part.patient_id AND block.snapshot_version = part.snapshot_version AND block.publication_id = part.publication_id AND block.part_key = part.part_key LEFT JOIN wsi_slide_placement placement ON placement.cancer_study_id = block.cancer_study_id AND placement.patient_id = block.patient_id AND placement.snapshot_version = block.snapshot_version AND placement.publication_id = block.publication_id AND placement.part_key = block.part_key AND placement.block_key = block.block_key LEFT JOIN wsi_slide slide ON slide.cancer_study_id = placement.cancer_study_id AND slide.patient_id = placement.patient_id AND slide.snapshot_version = placement.snapshot_version AND slide.publication_id = placement.publication_id AND slide.image_id = placement.image_id LEFT JOIN sample portal_sample ON portal_sample.internal_id = placement.sample_id WHERE study.cancer_study_identifier = #{studyId} AND portal_patient.stable_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY sample_id, part.part_key, block.block_key, slide.image_id
